question: What are the sids for sailors who reserved red or blue boats?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "boats" AS SELECT "b" AS "b", "name" AS "name", "clr" AS "clr" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "reserves" AS SELECT "sid" AS "sid", "date_value_pairs" AS "date_value_pairs" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "sailors" AS SELECT "sid" AS "sid", "name" AS "name", "rating" AS "rating", "age" AS "age" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT r.sid,
           TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pair, ':', 2)) AS boat_id_str
    FROM reserves r,
         UNNEST(STRING_SPLIT(r.date_value_pairs, ',')) AS pair
), parsed AS (
    SELECT sid, TRY_CAST(boat_id_str AS BIGINT) AS b
    FROM exploded
    WHERE boat_id_str IS NOT NULL AND boat_id_str <> ''
), rb AS (
    SELECT b.b AS b, b.clr
    FROM boats b
    WHERE LOWER(b.clr) IN ('red','blue')
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.sid
FROM parsed p
JOIN rb ON p.b = rb.b
ORDER BY p.sid;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH pairs AS (
    SELECT r.sid,
           UNNEST(STRING_SPLIT(r.date_value_pairs, ',')) AS pair
    FROM reserves r
), exploded AS (
    SELECT sid,
           TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pair, ':', 2)) AS boat_id_str
    FROM pairs
), parsed AS (
    SELECT sid, TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(boat_id_str, '\.(0+)$', '') AS BIGINT) AS b
    FROM exploded
    WHERE boat_id_str IS NOT NULL AND boat_id_str <> ''
), rb AS (
    SELECT b AS b, clr
    FROM boats
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(clr)) IN ('red','blue')
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.sid
FROM parsed p
JOIN rb ON p.b = rb.b
ORDER BY p.sid;

# Split reserves.date_value_pairs on commas, then split each pair on ':' to get boat_id; join to red/blue boats and return distinct sids
sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH pairs AS (
    SELECT r.sid,
           UNNEST(STRING_SPLIT(r.date_value_pairs, ',')) AS pair
    FROM reserves r
), exploded AS (
    SELECT sid,
           TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pair, ':', 2)) AS boat_id_str
    FROM pairs
), parsed AS (
    SELECT sid, TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(boat_id_str, '\\.(0+)$', '') AS BIGINT) AS b
    FROM exploded
    WHERE boat_id_str IS NOT NULL AND boat_id_str <> ''
), rb AS (
    SELECT b AS b, clr
    FROM boats
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(clr)) IN ('red','blue')
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.sid
FROM parsed p
JOIN rb ON p.b = rb.b
ORDER BY p.sid;
'''
